## Change Summary

Describe the smallest complete change.

## Change Class

- [ ] C0 Editorial
- [ ] C1 Implementation
- [ ] C2 Input/Data
- [ ] C3 Protocol
- [ ] C4 Claim
- [ ] C5 Release
- [ ] C6 Security

## Scientific and Release Impact

List affected claims, protocols, artifacts, manifests, manuscripts, and release
objects. State `None` where applicable.

## Evidence and Verification

List commands, exit codes, report paths, and exact hashes where material.

- [ ] I inspected the worktree and did not overwrite unrelated work.
- [ ] Frozen records were preserved or explicitly superseded.
- [ ] Tests/audits were run and exact failures are disclosed.
- [ ] New data have source, terms, lineage, and hashes.
- [ ] Claim wording does not exceed the current gate.
- [ ] No secrets or insecure TLS behavior were introduced.

## Review Roles Required

List scientific owner, data steward, verifier, claim reviewer, release manager,
or security steward as applicable.
